reason: The hexagonal cell, Z=3 content, and a physically plausible Yb-dominated average framework are well supported by the peak positions and intensity correlation, but exact recovery is not sufficiently established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the trace relied on custom stick/profile objectives rather than a common final whole-profile comparison; the remaining integrated-intensity discrepancies are larger than the profile noise. The submitted pair covers only the powder-identical enantiomorphs of one P3121 realization. Lower-symmetry P31/P32 realizations, the near-R32 parent distortion, and materially different Mg/Yb ordering/coordinate solutions were not exhaustively instantiated and compared under the same metric. Thus the data support the cell/framework more strongly than the submitted symmetry, coordinates, and light-element ordering, and another solution attempt is scientifically warranted.
